items.source: Returns the request parameter to be used to expose the projection to the web.
items.translation: 返回用于将投影暴露给 Web 的请求参数。

items.source: Returns the projection type for the given source type and name.
items.translation: 返回给定源类型和名称的投影类型。

items.source: Returns whether we have a projection registered for the given source type.
items.translation: 返回是否已为给定的源类型注册了投影。

items.source:
Interface to allow the lookup of a projection interface by source type and name. This allows the definition of
projections with the same name for different source types.
items.translation: 提供通过源类型和名称查找投影接口的接口。这使得可以为不同的源类型定义同名投影。

items.source: name - must not be null or empty.
the parameterName will never be null or empty.
items.translation: 参数名称绝不会为 null 或空。
